title: A computational approach to investigate TDP-43 C-terminal fragments aggregation in Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
authors: Greta Grassmann; Mattia Miotto; Lorenzo Di Rienzo; Federico Salaris; Beatrice Silvestri; Elsa Zacco; Alessandro Rosa; Gian Gaetano Tartaglia; Giancarlo Ruocco; Edoardo Milanetti
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和Zernike多项式表面互补性分析，研究TDP-43 C端片段聚集机制，虽涉及RNA/DNA结合蛋白但聚焦蛋白自身聚集而非TF-DNA互作，方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA界面建模。
abstract: Many of the molecular mechanisms underlying the pathological aggregation of proteins observed in neurodegenerative diseases are still not fully understood. Among the diseases associated with protein aggregates, for example, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) is of relevant importance. Although understanding the processes that cause the disease is still an open challenge, its relationship with protein aggregation is widely known. In particular, human TDP-43, an RNA/DNA binding protein, is a major component of pathological cytoplasmic inclusions described in ALS patients. The deposition of the phosphorylated full-length TDP-43 in spinal cord cells has been widely studied, and it has been shown that the brain cortex presents an accumulation of phosphorylated C-terminal fragments (CTFs). Even if it is debated whether CTFs represent a primary cause of ALS, they are a hallmark of TDP-43 related neurodegeneration in the brain. Here, we investigate the CTFs aggregation process, providing a possible computational model of interaction based on the evaluation of shape complementarity at the interfaces. To this end, extensive Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations were conducted for different types of fragments with the aim of exploring the equilibrium configurations. Adopting a newly developed approach based on Zernike polynomials, for finding complementary regions of the molecular surface, we sampled a large set of exposed portions of the molecular surface of CTFs structures as obtained from MD simulations. The analysis proposes a set of possible associations between the CTFs, which could drive the aggregation process of the CTFs.
abstract_zh: 神经退行性疾病中观察到的蛋白质病理性聚集所涉及的许多分子机制仍未完全阐明。在与蛋白质聚集体相关的疾病中，例如肌萎缩侧索硬化症（Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, ALS）具有重要相关性。尽管理解导致该疾病的机制仍是一个未解挑战，但其与蛋白质聚集的关系已广为人知。特别是，人源TDP-43，一种RNA/DNA结合蛋白，是ALS患者中描述的病理性胞质包涵体的主要成分。磷酸化全长TDP-43在脊髓细胞中的沉积已被广泛研究，并且已表明大脑皮层呈现磷酸化C端片段（C-terminal fragments, CTFs）的积累。即使关于CTFs是否代表ALS的主要病因仍存在争议，它们也是大脑中TDP-43相关神经退行性变的标志。在此，我们研究CTFs的聚集过程，提供一种基于界面形状互补性评估的可能计算交互模型。为此，对不同类型的片段进行了广泛的分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，旨在探索平衡构象。采用一种基于Zernike多项式的新开发方法，用于寻找分子表面的互补区域，我们从MD模拟获得的CTFs结构中采样了大量暴露的分子表面部分。该分析提出了CTFs之间一系列可能的关联，这些关联可能驱动CTFs的聚集过程。
